authority.note: Discovery coverage evidence only; screening tiers order work and never exclude or decide. M5 stays unaccepted (Cory).

stopping_rule.definition: a signal pass is material if it gives a first signal to >= 3 eligible cards with screening score >= 25.0, or newly escalates any card; expansion stops after 2 consecutive non-material rounds; the full-pool sweep then admits every eligible card
stopping_rule.test_tier_rule: escalated cards ranked by score + 5 x reasons; the first PAIRED_TARGET are paired_test, the rest escalated_queued (kept, run in later batches); others screen_only. Workload order, never exclusion

inputs: data/grixis/blueprints/ashnod-the-uncaring.json#packages (members not in list, candidates, package-type matches)
grixis_refine.HOOKS (commander_specific and blueprint_package specificity; generic hooks only score)
none: no tournament evidence file for this deck
oracle_bulk: every card Commander-legal (or authorized project exception), in colour identity, not in the list
